# Rentoule Projects

> Rentoule Projects is a Canberra residential builder (ACT, Australia) delivering home renovations, extensions and custom new homes, from mid-range through to luxury, with completed renovation projects shown on the site. A small team led by director and licensed builder Jeff Rentoule, with every contract fixed-price and the design, selections and pricing worked through before construction begins.

Key facts:
- Director: Jeff Rentoule, licensed builder with 19 years in the Canberra building industry.
- Licences: ACT 20211145, NSW 453726C. ABN 16 647 366 461.
- Services: home renovations, home extensions, and custom new homes including knockdown rebuilds. The site also publishes guides on Mr Fluffy blocks and dual occupancy.
- How we price: fixed-price building contracts, with scope, selections and pricing agreed before construction starts; changes to scope are priced in writing before the work happens.
- Typical investment: most clients invest between $300,000 and $900,000, and some projects are considerably larger.
- Reviews: rated 5.0 on Google (19 reviews as of November 2026).
- Contact: phone 0434 435 966, email info@rentouleprojects.com, or https://rentouleprojects.com/contact/

Service areas (ACT and NSW; further for the right project):
- Inner North: Turner, Braddon, Campbell, Ainslie, Reid, Dickson, O’Connor, Hackett
- Inner South & Woden: Yarralumla, Griffith, Forrest, Deakin, Red Hill, Narrabundah, Garran, Hughes
- Molonglo Valley: Denman Prospect, Wright, Coombs, Whitlam, Molonglo, Macnamara
- Wider Canberra & Queanbeyan: Weetangera, Holder, Curtin, Kambah, Queanbeyan, Jerrabomberra, Googong, Bungendore
- NSW South Coast: Batemans Bay, Broulee, Mollymook, Ulladulla, Moruya, Tuross Head
